title: Seya orders the swing round the east of Tengxian

records.says: 支隊ハ界河、東郭、王廟方面ヨリ王廟附近ニ向ヒ前進シ滕県敵陣地ニ対スル攻撃ヲ準備セントス
records.label: 瀬支作命第九号, "三月十五日午前十時三十分於界河" (the detachment advances by 界河, 東郭 and 王廟 to prepare the attack on Tengxian)

records.says: 主力（歩兵五中隊）ヲ以テ歩六三ノ後方ニ續行シ敵ノ備ヘ薄キ東方地區ヨリ滕縣附近ノ敵ヲ攻撃スルコトヽナル
records.label: the 10th Regiment, on receiving it (its main body of five companies follows the 63rd and attacks from the weakly held east)

title: When the line at 界河 broke
reading: The village entered on the 14th; the line round it given up at 13:00 on the 15th
basis: The 63rd's record is of the village; the Chinese one of the whole line from 界河 to 龍山, which Seya's order of 10:30 on the 15th, issued at 界河, shows was still held east of it.

records.says: 13时，界河正面阵地被日军突破
records.label: 15 March

title: Which way the Japanese swung round the city
reading: By 東郭 and 王廟, east and south-east of the city
basis: The Japanese orders and the 10th Regiment's report give the route; 龍陽店 appears in no Japanese record and may have been a flank screen.

records.says: 前衛ハ正午龍山店附近出発 龍山店―東郭 王廟道ニ沿フ地区ヲ王廟ニ向ヒ前進スヘシ
records.label: 瀬支作命第九号 (the advance guard leaves 龍山店 at noon along the 龍山店–東郭–王廟 road)

records.says: 以万余兵力由龙山东侧向滕县城迂回…下午5时许，其先头部队已达滕县城东北的龙阳店、冯河一带
records.label: 《滕县志》 (over ten thousand round the east of 龍山; by 17:00 the van was at 龍陽店 and 馮河, north-east of the city)

title: Yan Yi's battalion reaches the city

records.label: of the 731st Regiment only Yan Yi's 1st Battalion reached the city
